title: Living room: hearth wall, ribbon window and oak entry screen

openings.label: Ribbon window

openings.pattern: five equal fixed lights with 40 mm mullions

furniture.item: Entry screen with coat store and shoe drawers
furniture.material: European oak veneer carcass with solid oak slats
furniture.position_note: Runs north-south from y 1.50 to the north wall, 1.00 m off the west wall, built up to the 2.15 m soffit. South 1.20 m (y 1.50-2.70) is a closed coat cupboard with hooks and shoe drawers on the vestibule face; north 1.50 m (y 2.70-4.20) is open vertical slats at 40/40 mm so window light reaches the vestibule. Clear of the door swing (x 0-0.90, y 0.30-1.20).

furniture.item: Three-seat sofa (2.20 m) facing the fireplace
furniture.material: solid beech frame, feather-wrapped foam, moss green wool boucle upholstery
furniture.finish: upholstered, low 0.78 m back, oak block feet
furniture.position_note: Rotated to run north-south (seat faces east to the fire); back 0.15 m off the entry screen. Footprint x 1.60-2.50, y 1.00-3.20, centred on the room and fire axis at y 2.10. South arm sits on the circulation path edge; nearest corner is 1.62 m from the door centre.

furniture.material: solid European oak slab top on blackened steel flat-bar base
furniture.position_note: 0.50 m in front of the sofa, long side north-south, centred on y 2.10; east edge at x 3.70 keeps 0.35 m clear of the 0.90 m path band (x 4.05-4.95).

furniture.item: Window ledge unit: low bookshelf and lamp ledge
furniture.material: European oak veneer with solid oak lipping
furniture.position_note: Against the north wall under the west end of the ribbon window, x 1.60-3.15; open shelving facing the room; top at the 0.42 m datum shared with the window seat and hearth plinths. 0.05 m shadow gap to the window seat.

furniture.material: European oak veneer box with drawer, ochre heavy-linen seat and back cushions
furniture.position_note: Against the north wall under the east part of the ribbon window, x 3.20-5.00; seat top 0.42 m, cushion back against the 0.58 m of wall below the 1.00 m sill. Forms the north arm of the L-shaped seating group with the sofa. 0.05 m reveal to the north hearth plinth.

furniture.material: honed grey basalt slabs on blockwork; blackened steel firebox surround; sealed glass-fronted insert flued in the east wall
furniture.position_note: Centred on the east wall at y 2.10, 1.60 m wide, 0.45 m deep, floor to ceiling. Fire opening 0.90 x 0.50 m cut into its face at 0.42-0.92 m above floor. Flush with and continuous with the hearth plinths either side (one stone element modelled as three abutting footprints).
Low stone ledge along the east wall from the south wall to the chimney breast; recessed linear uplight slot along its back edge washes the lime plaster above. Not counted as seating.

furniture.item: Hearth plinth, north, with oak-lined log niche
furniture.material: honed grey basalt with oak-lined niche
furniture.position_note: Low stone ledge from the chimney breast to the north wall; log niche 0.60 x 0.30 m cut into its face at y 3.25-3.85. Recessed linear uplight slot along its back edge. Not counted as seating.
In the pocket between the sofa's north arm (y 3.20), the window ledge unit (y 3.65) and the entry screen (x 1.45); lights the sofa's north seat.
Under the front half of the sofa and the whole coffee table, x 1.95-4.00, y 1.05-3.55; stops short of the 0.90 m path band at x 4.05 and the south corridor at y 0.95.

circulation.description: From the door centre into the vestibule, east along the south side of the room (1.00 m clear between the south wall and the sofa/table), then north in front of the hearth (1.35 m clear between the coffee table at x 3.70 and the plinth face at x 5.05), ending 0.55 m from the fire. The sofa's south arm sits directly on the path edge, so the path serves the principal seating and the fireplace.

decision_log.decision: Fireplace placed on the east short wall as a full-width basalt plinth with a central full-height chimney breast.
decision_log.rationale: The long axis terminates on the hearth, both long walls stay free for the ribbon window and the sofa back, and the principal elevation reads as one symmetric low composition.

decision_log.decision: Ribbon window on the north wall, 3.75 m long (68% of 5.50 m), sill 1.00 m, head 2.00 m.
decision_log.rationale: Even north light avoids glare on the fire-facing seating; a 2.00 m head leaves a 0.30 m pocket for blinds and the concealed light under a 2.30 m ceiling.

decision_log.decision: Entry door on the west wall at the south-west corner, with a 0.45 m deep oak screen and coat store forming a 1.00 m wide vestibule.
decision_log.rationale: The screen is the named entry element between door and seating; the door centre is 1.62 m from the nearest seating footprint and no seating is visible on axis from the door.

decision_log.decision: Dropped limewashed soffit at 2.15 m over the vestibule and screen.
decision_log.rationale: A compressed threshold makes the 2.30 m living ceiling feel taller on arrival and houses the entry downlights.

decision_log.decision: Seating for five as a three-seat sofa facing the fire plus a 1.80 m built-in window seat for two, arranged as an L around a low table.
decision_log.rationale: Five seats without a second freestanding sofa keeps the 1.00 m south corridor clear and the room uncluttered; the window seat uses the depth under the ribbon window.

decision_log.decision: One continuous 0.42 m datum: hearth plinths, window seat and ledge unit share the same height, and the fire opening sits on it.
decision_log.rationale: A single low horizontal line running round two walls stretches the room and keeps everything below eye level in a low space.

decision_log.decision: Circulation runs along the south side of the room (1.00 m clear) and turns north in front of the hearth.
decision_log.rationale: The path reaches the sofa and the fire without cutting through the seating group or crossing the rug.

decision_log.decision: No pendants; light comes from concealed linear sources at the window head, plinth shadow gaps and under the ledge, plus one floor lamp and one table lamp.
decision_log.rationale: Hanging fittings would read as obstacles under a 2.30 m ceiling; grazing light along the long walls emphasises length.

decision_log.decision: All wall and joinery surfaces matt: lime plaster, honed basalt, oiled oak.
decision_log.rationale: Meets the no-mirror, no-gloss constraint and avoids reflections that would make the low ceiling and ribbon glazing busy.

decision_log.decision: Smoked oak wide boards laid east-west along the room length.
decision_log.rationale: Boards running the long way reinforce the long, low proportion and link vestibule, living zone and hearth as one floor.
